body.value: Refers to what the utamakura specifically conjures up in the poems and texts. For example, in the case of "Otowa", it often appears in more concrete forms than "Otowa", such as "Otowa mountain", "Otowa river", "Otowa waterfall" and "Otowa village". Mainly Katagiri Yōichi's Utamakura utakotoba jiten was consulted for reference.
